WITH step1 AS (
  SELECT 
    p.SEX,
    COUNT(*) as count
  FROM Laboratory l
  JOIN Patient p ON l.ID = p.ID
  WHERE p.SEX != ''
  GROUP BY p.SEX
),
step2 AS (
  SELECT SUM(count) as total_count
  FROM step1
),
step3 AS (
  SELECT 
    s1.SEX,
    s1.count,
    CAST(s1.count AS REAL) / s2.total_count as ratio
  FROM step1 s1
  CROSS JOIN step2 s2
  WHERE s2.total_count IS NOT NULL
),
step4 AS (
  SELECT AVG(count) as avg_count
  FROM step3
)
SELECT 
  s3.SEX,
  s3.count,
  s3.ratio,
  s3.count - s4.avg_count as difference
FROM step3 s3
CROSS JOIN step4 s4
WHERE s4.avg_count IS NOT NULL
AND s3.count > s4.avg_count
